body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Bixolon(www.samsungminiprinters.com) expects to present its handy-sized mobile receipt printer 'SPP-R200' at the upcoming CES 2008, which offers fast, on-demand printing with speed of up to 80mm per second.
Utilizing a Lithium-ion battery with a 6.2-hour continuous operation life, the SPP-R200 supports a magnetic card reader function allowing credit cards to be processed.
